compatibility: v1.2 and frozen Pilot outputs remain byte-for-byte unchanged. This is a proposed additive semantic contract, not an activated provider schema or RPC payload.
product_principle: 대학의 평가 기준에 따라 지금 가장 먼저 고쳐야 할 부분을 찾고, 구체적인 첨삭과 재작성을 통해 한 단계씩 더 나은 답안을 완성하도록 돕는다.
inherit: All v1.2 rules, student Korean, stance preservation, minimal editing and official criterion priority.

core_focus.selection: Official university criteria override the default order; select actionable root issues, not a quota.
core_focus.overflow: Keep material findings in detailed criterion diagnosis; group shared roots. Never hide necessary guidance or misrepresent severity to sell another evaluation.

fields.observation_key: Evaluation-local unique string, never a global weakness ID
fields.linked_issue_key: Must resolve to one current improvement progress; server assigns real issue/progress UUIDs
fields.end: Unicode code-point integer, exclusive; greater than start
fields.quote: Exact sentence/span from this evaluation’s immutable submitted attempt, no normalization
fields.diagnosis: Specific friendly Korean, not a preference asserted as error
fields.example: Optional nonblank minimal example; omitted if unnecessary

sentence_feedback.relationship: Supports selected core issues. A justified local sentence task may exist outside the core list; no separate duplicate root criticism.
sentence_feedback.duplicate_policy: One progress per root/evaluation. Distinct sentence observations can share that root. Same span must not be repeated under multiple roots; combine genuinely co-located guidance.

input_snapshot_addition.source: Server-selected compatible completed earlier evaluation in same session/owner/question, with source attempt hash and immutable progress IDs. Include previous title, explanation, action, status and evidence through references in worker payload; never profile/PII.
input_snapshot_addition.selection: Record selected predecessor at request time; no moving latest lookup during finalize. Same-attempt re-evaluation is not rewrite growth. Old v1.2 outputs lack explicit core_focus: no automatic retroactive conversion.
input_snapshot_addition.no_history: Empty lists with an explicit unavailable/incompatible reason; no invented progression.

output_additions.core_improvement_keys: Ordered unique subset of current improvements, 0..3 by default. Persist core_focus with each progress and existing priority as order.
output_additions.previous_improvement_reviews: Exactly one review per snapshotted previous core progress ID before selecting new focus. Optional explicit reviews of prior resolved issues may establish recurrence.

improvement_extension_fields.claim_scope: official_criterion or local_sentence; trusted adapter validates semantics, never trust provider scope as authorization
improvement_extension_fields.previous_progress_id: Explicit predecessor for assessed previous review
improvement_extension_fields.core_focus: Derived by server from core_improvement_keys; resolved issues cannot be active core

previous_review.assessed: Create new progress linked to the exact prior progress and same issue; never update past rows.
previous_review.not_assessable: No progress assertion. Persist required uncertainty reason in evaluation.uncertainty_note; input predecessor list minus linked assessed progress identifies unknown tasks. Missing observation is not resolved or unchanged.
previous_review.recurrence: Requires an explicitly referenced earlier resolved observation on the comparable branch and current evidence; cross-session normalized keys are only candidates, not automatic identity merging.

progression_rules: Review prior core tasks before looking for new ones; collect and validate full output before atomic publication.
If unresolved, offer smaller steps, clearer cause, exact quote or optional short example; do not repeat old action unchanged.
Move to next priority only with recorded resolved/improved evidence; a newly severe error can take priority, with explanation.
Student labels: open/unchanged=아직 확인할 부분, improved=좋아지고 있는 부분, resolved=해결한 부분, recurred=다시 나타난 부분; not_assessable=판단이 어려운 부분.
No claimed trend from missing observations, incomparable regimes or one sample. Preserve strengths and do not classify permanent weakness.

provenance.official: Existing essay_evaluation_evidence FK to allowed question/criterion evidence; mandatory for university-criterion judgments.
provenance.student_quote: Server-resolved evaluation → submitted attempt → answer hash → exact code-point slice. Separate from official evidence table.
provenance.both: Criterion/application/logical judgment with a sentence location retains official mapping AND verified quote.
provenance.quote_only_exception: Only a trusted-classified local sentence claim, including internal contradiction, that does not assert university criteria or passage interpretation. Active finding requires a verified own quote and diagnosis/direction. Provider claim_scope alone never grants the exception.
provenance.inference: Having a quote does not prove a diagnosis true; provenance mode and pedagogic merit need semantic review, not just enum checks.
provenance.resolved_local_exception: A resolved prior local sentence issue may have no current sentence_feedback: require explicit verified predecessor, current immutable answer/hash and trusted review of the resolution reason. Do not fabricate an erroneous sentence to prove resolution. This is a progress disposition, not a new sentence finding.

server_validation: Resolve evaluation/attempt/owner/question/hash from trusted job, never provider IDs or draft.
Validate exact quote, types/enums/nonblank fields, bounds, root links, total count <=5 and duplicates across the whole evaluation.
Validate all previous core reviews and predecessor membership/chronology/regime. Unknown is not completion.
Validate core subset/count/order and no duplicate roots. Preserve all required university dimensions regardless of focus budget.
Validate official evidence membership; narrowly allow quote-only local observations; do not relax dimension evidence validation.
Atomic finalize stores progress/observations/evidence plus result/settlement; any invalid fragment rejects the entire output.
Contract, prompt, regime and manifest versions are server-controlled. Old in-flight v1.2 jobs retain old handling.

shape.sentences: array of sentence fields excluding linked_issue_key (parent issue_id supplies relation)

storage_proposal.limits: 0..5 sentences per envelope AND <=5 summed across evaluation; <=3 core_focus=true by default; root-specific diagnosis/action stay in existing columns; sentence-specific diagnosis/direction are distinct local guidance.
storage_proposal.historical_null: Legacy/unsupported contract, not zero findings. New v1.3 progress uses explicit envelope, including empty sentences.
storage_proposal.reason_for_envelope: Persist which tasks were core without inferring from priority or labels; allow multiple sentence locations for the same root despite UNIQUE(issue_id,evaluation_id).

quality_review: No invented errors; preferences labeled as suggestions.
No unstated stance/conclusion or wholesale AI style replacement.
No full answer disguised as a minimal sentence example.
Quotes only from that student’s submitted answer.
Necessary feedback never withheld for payment; full example remains secondary.
activation_gates: Minimal persistence and versioned RPC adapter implementation
Isolated PostgreSQL/JWT, history, quote/provenance and billing regression tests
Separate approval for Scaffolding AI Pilot
